trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Plan the whole list around it — clear the story first, keep the missable stranger chains and meditation spots in mind as you go, and leave the long counters (stunts, WAiNK scans, tracked choices) ticking in the background of everything else. A full completionist run is measured in the hundreds of hours, so pace the grinds in parallel rather than saving them all for the end.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (55 trophies, roughly 200 hours to the platinum); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. It cannot be missed: play through the prologue, learn the movement, driving and cover basics it teaches, and the trophy pops as the mission wraps up. Like every story trophy it is hidden on PlayStation, so it stays masked in the console list until the moment you earn it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list (12 hidden story trophies); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide roadmap.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1 after the prologue. Story trophies are unmissable and pop in order, so simply follow the mission markers to the chapter's end. While you are in this chapter, keep an eye out for the meditation opportunity the guides flag for Positive Mental Attitude — that trophy is missable, and this chapter is where its earliest spot appears.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide (Chapter 1 meditation spot counts toward Positive Mental Attitude); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. The name is printed partly masked, exactly as PlayStation publishes it. As with the other chapter trophies this is unmissable: work through the chapter's missions in order and it pops at the chapter break. Stranger chains begin opening up around this part of the game — start them when they appear rather than stockpiling them, because the chains run on story-progress windows.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (stranger chains reported to run on story-progress windows); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Unmissable story progress: finish the chapter's missions and the trophy pops at its conclusion. By this point the map and most systems are open, so it is a good moment to start the tracked counters in earnest — stunts, WAiNK locations and activity types all build fastest when they run alongside the story instead of after it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Unmissable: play the chapter through and it pops at the end. Treat this as your final warning point — before you push into the finale, check the missables panel in this guide and close out any stranger chains you still have open, because their windows are tied to story progress.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (missable warnings); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the only gold among the twelve story trophies and, like them, it is hidden until earned. Go into the finale stocked and with your missables settled: the stranger chains and the meditation trophy are the things players most often discover too late at this point. Once the credits roll, the full 100% checklist opens up and the endgame phase of the platinum begins.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (the hidden gold; 100% checklist opens after the story); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is one of the named-mission story trophies, all of them hidden and all of them unmissable: the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen when Breakfast Run ends. No preparation or side condition is involved — if you are playing the campaign, this one is already on your path.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A hidden, unmissable story trophy: it pops when the heist mission ends, however your run through it went. Heists later in the game build on what this mission teaches, but for the trophy itself there is nothing to optimise — finish the mission and move on.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Hidden and unmissable, like every named-mission trophy: the award lands on the mission-complete screen. There are no branching conditions to manage for the trophy itself, so play the mission as it comes.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. One of the twelve hidden story trophies and impossible to miss while playing the campaign: finish the mission and the trophy pops. Nothing in the mission needs a particular outcome, vehicle or score for the award.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Hidden and unmissable story progress: the trophy pops when the mission ends. The VCIA location returns later for the hidden feat Catch Me If You Can, so it is worth learning your way around the place while this mission walks you through it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission story bronzes: hidden until earned and unmissable on a campaign playthrough. Finish the operation and the trophy pops on completion, leaving only the chapter and finale trophies between you and the end of the story set.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion). The full checklist only opens up after the credits, so treat the story as phase one and the checklist as the real campaign: story, strands, activities, collectibles and challenges all feed into it. It is widely rated the hardest trophy on the list and the main reason the platinum runs to roughly 200 hours — chip at the checklist categories in parallel instead of clearing them strictly one at a time, and use the counter here to mirror your in-game percentage.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (hardest trophy; roughly 200 hours); GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. The stunt spots are scattered across the whole state of Leonida and each one counts when you land it cleanly, so this is a coverage grind rather than a skill wall. Work region by region and clear stunts whenever you pass one instead of saving all 250 for a single sweep, and use a fast, durable vehicle or a bike so a failed landing costs you seconds rather than a long reset. The count is tracked, so log your progress here as you go and let the map thin out district by district.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description (250 stunts); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide; Push Square GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Take part in each of the 9 activity types at least once — a taste of each is enough, mastery is not required. The efficient route is one deliberate tour: start a session of every distinct activity the map offers (the races, ranges, challenges and pastimes that open as you play), and the trophy pops when the last new type registers. Because several activities only unlock as the story opens the map, most players finish this naturally mid-campaign; use the counter here to note which types you have touched.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list (9 activity types); Push Square GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Golds are score-based, so the pattern for each challenge is what you are really learning: fire a sighting run, note where the targets bunch, then replay immediately while the layout is fresh in your hands. Because the trophy asks for every single challenge at gold rather than a points total, treat it as several focused sessions instead of one marathon — your accuracy will fall off long before the list does. Track the 42 here as they turn gold.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide (42 Shooting Range challenges); Push Square GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — finishing is not enough, you must win at each location once. Take a sighting lap first if the course is new, then race it again straight away while the line through the gates is fresh. Drone handling rewards smooth, early inputs over full throttle in the corners, so brake with the stick rather than stabbing at it. Fourteen wins is a moderate grind; clear locations as you uncover them rather than touring all fourteen at the end.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list (14 Top Fun locations); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of a race you have already won do not add to the count, so keep moving to new race markers across the map instead of farming a favourite circuit. Any distinct event counts, which makes this a natural travelling trophy: win the local race whenever you arrive somewhere new and the twenty will be done well before the endgame. Log each new win here so you never waste a trip on a race that is already banked.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description (20 different races); GTABase GTA VI trophy guide; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge. Find Cal and take the challenge when it is offered: learn the cast-and-reel rhythm on a practice fish first, then keep steady tension during the contest and ease off when the fish runs so the line does not snap. It is a one-off contest rather than a grind — win it once and the trophy is yours. Fishing also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None, so this visit does double duty.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; Push Square GTA VI trophy guide; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play a cabinet through to its actual end rather than just starting it and walking away. If several cabinets are available, pick the shortest game on offer and this becomes one of the quickest bronzes on the whole list. An arcade session also registers as an activity type for Master of None, so your one completion pulls double weight.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete Andy's stranger chain all the way to his final mission. Start his strand when it first appears and keep returning between story missions: guide coverage reports the stranger chains run on windows tied to story progress, so a chain left hanging while you push the campaign can close for good. The trophy itself is hidden and only reveals itself when the finale is done. If you are anywhere near a chapter break and Andy's chain is still open, finish the chain first.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (stranger chains have story-progress windows); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete Kenton's stranger chain through to his final mission. The same rule as every stranger finale applies: guide coverage reports these chains are tied to story progress, so pick Kenton's strand up when it appears and see it through instead of leaving it for a post-story sweep that may never come. The trophy is hidden until the finale lands, so use the tracker here to remember the chain is done.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (stranger chains have story-progress windows); GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete Billy's stranger chain through to his final mission. Billy's strand, like the other four stranger finales, sits behind a hidden trophy and a story-progress window: start it when it surfaces, finish it before the campaign moves too far past it, and do not assume a chain you met early will still be waiting after the credits. When the finale is complete the hidden trophy reveals itself.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (stranger chains have story-progress windows); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand means a character's whole chain, not a single first meeting — the five chains behind the missable finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone), Bret's hunting work and the other strangers you encounter all count toward the eight. Finish chains as they open rather than stockpiling introductions, because chains are exactly the content with story windows on it. Eight complete strands is also a requirement the 100% checklist will ask about later, so this silver is never wasted effort.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description (8 mission strands); PSNProfiles trophy list; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete Randy's stranger chain through to his final mission. Randy's finale is one of the five hidden stranger trophies whose chains guide coverage ties to story progress: meet him when the strand appears, work it between story missions, and close it out before the campaign's later chapters. Leave it too long and the window can shut, taking the trophy — and one of your eight Strangers & Freaks strands — with it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (stranger chains have story-progress windows); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete Tyrone's stranger chain through to his final mission. Treat Tyrone's strand like the other four finales: hidden trophy, story-linked window, no guarantee it survives into the post-game. Pick the chain up when it appears and finish it promptly; the five finales together are the backbone of the Strangers & Freaks silver, so every one you close early is progress on two trophies at once.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (stranger chains have story-progress windows); GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy the major guides single out: PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it as possibly missable, and PowerPyx reports that a meditation opportunity with Lucia in Chapter 1 counts toward the in-game total, which is why the safe play is to meditate at every spot the story puts in front of you instead of planning to sweep all 18 up at the end. After the story, work the remaining spots region by region and keep the count updated here — at 18 the trophy pops.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide (flagged possibly missable; Chapter 1 spot counts toward the total); GTABase GTA VI trophy guide (flagged possibly missable); EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (18 spots).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. This hidden trophy belongs to Bret's stranger strand, so take his hunting jobs as they come and the unique hunt will be offered as the chain builds. When the animal is marked, treat it as a one-animal pursuit: track it carefully, close the distance patiently and take a clean shot when it settles rather than chasing it across the county. The trophy reveals itself when the hunt is handed in.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list (hidden, non-story); EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Individual cards are scattered all over Leonida, but a set only counts when every card in it is in your hands, so the winning habit is focus: pick the sets you are closest to finishing and complete those, rather than scattering single pickups across every set at once. Sweep for cards district by district while you are in an area for other work, and note here which sets are nearly done so trips can be planned around them.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description (3 Collectible Card sets); GTABase GTA VI trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 different locations. The WAiNK points are spread across the entire state, which makes this a coverage grind: scan whenever you arrive somewhere new — businesses, landmarks and stops each count once — and the hundred builds steadily if you make it a habit from the first hours. Players who ignore it until the endgame face a long deliberate sweep; players who scan as they travel usually find most of the 100 already done. Keep the running total here.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description (100 locations); PSNProfiles trophy list; Push Square GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game holds more challenges than the fifty you need — and the 100% checklist will ask for more of them than this trophy does — so you can afford to pick the ones that suit how you play. Bank the quick situational challenges as they surface in free roam, keep a few reliable repeatables in rotation, and let the count climb here. Because A Long Road wants more challenges still, every completion past 50 is banked progress, not waste.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description (50 Challenges); EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With both protagonists together, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it completely and escape — the trophy needs the full arc, heat and clean getaway, with your partner present throughout. Deliberately raise the heat somewhere open, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain away; getting busted or wasted voids the attempt. A fast car and a hiding route chosen in advance (alleys, garages, off-road ground) make the escape half far more reliable than improvising it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops one after another with your partner, keeping your Wanted Level alive the whole time — if the heat drops between shops, the chain breaks and you start again. Plan a tight triangle of shops in a single neighbourhood so travel time never gives the wanted level room to lapse, keep moving between tills, and only break away and hide once the third shop is emptied. Rehearse the route once without robbing anything if the spacing feels uncertain.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a vehicle is discovered the first time you get into it. Variety is everywhere if you stop defaulting to one favourite car: swap vehicles at every opportunity, and sweep the places unusual metal gathers — parking lots, docks, airfields, wealthy districts, depots and emergency scenes. Spread across a long playthrough this lands almost on its own; use the counter here and pair it with On the Spot by registering new finds to the Scooter Bros app as you discover them.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description (100 vehicles); Push Square GTA VI trophy guide; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus activation. Set the shot up before you trigger it: find a fight with at least five enemies in the open — a gang spot or a mission firefight — thin nobody out beforehand, line them up, then activate Focus and work through them methodically. All five must fall inside the one activation, so never waste a trigger pull on a lone target when you are hunting this.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at the VCIA — in practice, take an aircraft (or another departing vehicle) and get out of there without clearance rather than by any booked, legitimate route. You will know the airfield from the story mission VCIA Takedown. Get in, get moving and get airborne before the response closes the attempt down; the hidden trophy pops as your unscheduled departure registers.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (hidden, non-story); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The cryptic description is the clue: Rhinos are tanks, and it gets hot inside them — guide coverage reads this hidden trophy as an encounter with a Rhino. Draw one out by bringing serious military attention down on yourself, then deal with the tank and live to tell the tale. Go in stocked with heavy weapons and an exit vehicle, and do not trade shots with the main cannon from the open — use cover, keep moving, and treat survival as part of the requirement, because the trophy reveals itself only when the encounter is behind you.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list (hidden, non-story); EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without ever being detected. Case the store first and learn where the staff and sightlines are, enter quietly, and keep the robbery fast and silent — no alarm tripped, no witness finishing a call. Leave by the least-watched exit you found while casing. If a detection indicator starts to build, stop what you are doing and let it settle rather than rushing the till; a slow clean robbery earns the trophy, a fast loud one earns a wanted level.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape after each one. Vault jobs are a step up from shop stick-ups: go in equipped, clear the vault, and have the escape route planned before the heat peaks, because a vault only counts if you actually get away — a bust at the door wastes the whole job. Five different vaults is the safe reading of the requirement, so spread the work across the map and log each clean getaway here.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description (5 Bank Vaults); GTABase GTA VI trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape with the take. Armored trucks run regular routes around the state: pick one on a quiet stretch of road, block it, crack it open with heavy firepower or explosives against the rear doors, grab the cash and break away before the response converges. Starting the job away from patrols gives you a clean first minute, which is usually all the head start the escape needs.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; Push Square GTA VI trophy guide; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — an area counts once you have uncovered it on the map. This is the whole state: the cities, the swamps, the keys and the countryside between them. A normal playthrough uncovers most of it; what remains is a systematic post-story road trip, region by region with the map as your checklist. Boats and aircraft earn their keep on the coastal and island edges, which are the areas land-only players most often leave grey.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (explore all of Leonida; 52 areas); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Only the first robbery against each gang moves this counter — nine gangs means nine separate first-time hits, and repeat hits on a gang you have already robbed pay cash but no progress. Spread the hits across your playthrough as you encounter new territory, and log each gang here, because by the seventh or eighth the question is never whether you robbed an operation, it is whose it was.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide (one operation per gang); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet hidden trophy and one of the cheapest on the list: head to the Ocean Beach front, find a beachfront spot that serves drinks with seating over the water, order the cocktail and let the little scene play out. It registers at the right venue rather than at just any bar, so if one place does not trigger it, walk the strip and try the next terrace with a view.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (hidden, non-story); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: get into one of the cars on the showroom floor and drive it straight out through the storefront glass. You need a showroom with an enterable car on display — pick your line at the glass rather than the door frame, build a little speed across the floor, and go through. The hidden trophy pops as you burst out; expect a wanted level to greet you on the pavement.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list (hidden, non-story); EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and bowl — the trophy is tied to the follow-through of your throw at this specific alley, so play a proper game there and finish your deliveries with a full follow-through rather than quitting after a frame or two. Bowling also registers as one of the activity types for Master of None, so the visit does double duty. It is a hidden trophy, so do not be surprised that nothing on the console list hinted at it beforehand.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (hidden, non-story); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a deliberately cryptic description: 'a partnership with mass appeal' points at the two protagonists and something they do together that draws attention. Guide coverage files it among the hidden one-off feats rather than any counter or grind, so there is no number to chase — it is a specific partnered moment waiting to be stumbled into or looked up. Play the duo content as it comes; if it still has not popped by the endgame, check the cited sources for the confirmed trigger before hunting blindly, because the wording alone will not get you there.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (hidden one-off feat); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks this hidden trophy to 500: it counts the choices you make — decisions and judgement calls across the story and side content — under a description that only says 'choices made (for better or worse)'. There is no single place to farm it, so the practical approach is volume: talk to people, take the side content, and actually make decisions instead of skipping through them, and the counter climbs on its own. Mirror the tracked number here as you go; if everything else is done and you are short, remaining strands and free-roam interactions are the top-up.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (counts to 500); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Another cryptic hidden one: 'second time's the charm' points at failing at something once and succeeding on the retry. For most players it pops without being hunted — the first time an attempt goes wrong and the immediate retry goes right, you are in this trophy's territory. If you are chasing it deliberately in the endgame, pick a quick repeatable challenge, fail it once on purpose, and clear it on the very next try.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (hidden one-off feat); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: By its name and its description — 'what the hell just happened?' — this hidden trophy is the list's strange-sighting award: witness something genuinely weird out in Leonida. Sightings like this are tied to odd places and odd hours rather than any counter, so treat it as an exploration secret: investigate the state's remote corners, and pay attention when the game goes quiet in the middle of nowhere at night. If it stays elusive, the cited sources are where confirmed sighting reports collect.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles trophy list (hidden, non-story); EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect with a pedestrian as you pass. A motorcycle at low speed along a busy pavement is the reliable setup — ride slowly, swing as you draw level, and the hidden trophy pops when someone goes down from the hit. Pick your spot with the consequences in mind: do it somewhere you can slip away from the wanted attention it may draw.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list (hidden, non-story); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come in from scores and robberies, and the discipline is simply to never sit on them: pass them to your laundering contacts whenever you are holding some, and the laundered total accumulates job by job. Made a habit after every big score, the quarter-million arrives well before the 100% push; left until the endgame, it is a long deliberate grind. Track the running total here in dollars.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description ($250,000 of Marked Bills); GTABase GTA VI trophy guide; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicle work, food and everything else all feed the one running total. There is no trick and no single place to do it: buy the gear you actually need as you play, favour the good stuff over the cheap stuff, and check the total here now and then. Most players cross six figures during the endgame without trying; if you are short late, restocking and upgrading at several shops closes the gap quickly.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description ($100,000 across all shops); Push Square GTA VI trophy guide; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages come up for sale as the game opens up, and every purchase is permanent progress, so buy them as your cash allows — cheapest first if money is tight — rather than saving them for one endgame spree. The last one or two are easy to forget once the whole map is open, so keep the count here and sweep the property listings before you declare the money stage finished.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; GTABase GTA VI trophy guide (8 garage properties); PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you get into a vehicle you like the look of, register it through the app there and then instead of meaning to come back to it — ten registrations is a small ask spread across a playthrough. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good: discover vehicles for that counter and register the keepers for this one, and both trophies advance on the same drive.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description (10 vehicles, Scooter Bros app); PSNProfiles trophy list; Push Square GTA VI trophy guide.

roadmap.title: Story First
roadmap.text: Play the campaign from Gone Fishing to the final mission: 12 story trophies (1 gold, 11 bronze), every one of them hidden until earned and none of them missable. Two things ride along with this stage — meditate at the Chapter 1 spot the guides flag for Positive Mental Attitude, and start every stranger chain that appears, because the chains run on story-progress windows.

roadmap.title: Stranger Strands
roadmap.text: Finish the stranger content: the five missable finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (all hidden), Bret's unique hunt, Cal's fishing challenge, and 8 complete strands for the Strangers & Freaks silver. Do these before the endgame wherever the story lets you — this is the stage where platinum runs are lost.

roadmap.title: Feats & Robberies
roadmap.text: The one-off bronzes: shop, jewelry and bank-vault robberies, the armored truck, one illegal operation per gang, the partnered wanted-level escapes, and the hidden discovery feats — the showroom smash, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the Rhino encounter and their cryptic friends. None of these needs a counter; each needs a small plan and a clean escape.

roadmap.title: Tracked Grinds
roadmap.text: The counters: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 14 drone-race wins, 20 different races, 50 challenges, 9 activity types, 18 meditation spots and 500 PSN-tracked choices. Most should already be part-done from the earlier stages; grind the remainders in focused sessions and keep the numbers updated in the tracker.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & Exploration
roadmap.text: Coverage trophies: 3 complete card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 discovered vehicles, all 52 areas of Leonida and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Work region by region with the map open — these reward systematic sweeping, not speed, and they pair well with whatever stage-4 grinds remain in the same districts.

roadmap.title: Money & 100%
roadmap.text: Close it out: launder $250,000 of Marked Bills, spend $100,000 across all shops and buy all 8 garage properties, then work the in-game checklist to 100% for A Long Road. When the other 54 are earned, Vice Got a Price! — the platinum, and the Leonida Legend title — pops on its own.
